coverage: A backed resource is unref'd through the control queue; the response is RESP_OK_NODATA, host accounting returns to zero, and scanout_resource is cleared before destruction.
A second unref of the same id returns RESP_ERR_INVALID_RESOURCE_ID, while a truncated unref request returns RESP_ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER and both publish used entries.
The resource-map lifecycle test covers create→attach→detach→remove and confirms the returned resource has no backing and accounting returns to baseline.
10,000 create/unref cycles across all six formats leave resource count and accounted bytes at baseline.
Device reset releases all resource and scanout state.

commands: cargo test -p wasm-vm-core --test virtio_mmio_slots --test virtio_blk --test virtio_net_critic

claim: At commit ecf0922, RESOURCE_UNREF removes only live resources, decrements exact host-pixel accounting, drops attached backing metadata, and clears scanout 0 before the resource can be freed. Unknown and malformed requests return bounded errors, reset tears down the same state, and 10,000 repeated lifecycles have zero net accounted-byte growth.
scope_notes: SET_SCANOUT and transfer/flush presentation remain owned by E5-T03; this slice proves the scanout binding cannot dangle when unref'd.
No independent-machine, WebKit, or host-layer rr run was used, per the user's direction and current repository evidence policy.
